reading.zh: 本层阅读顺序：订单、支付回调与退款 → B 币与电池钱包 → 大会员与权益 → 充电与支持订阅 → 结算、提现与对账。箭头语义：call 同步调用、event 异步事件、dataflow 数据/投影流、reference 契约引用。
reading.en: Read in order: Orders, Payment Callbacks and Refunds → Coin and Battery Wallet → Membership → Charging and Support Subscriptions → Settlement, Withdrawal and Reconciliation. Arrow kinds: call, event, dataflow, reference.
